# OpenSKP license source

`LICENSE` is the verbatim MIT license from the OpenSKP source revision pinned
in `requirements.txt`:

https://github.com/iamahsanmehmood/openskp/blob/291700bc213655a00461838de71e5f206311e619/LICENSE

The installed OpenSKP wheel used for the Windows build does not include a
license file in its `.dist-info` metadata, so frozen distributions bundle this
copy alongside the wheel metadata.
